test.command: PATH=".venv-ag-tests/bin:$PATH" make test && if [ -f Cargo.toml ] || [ -f rust-ag/Cargo.toml ]; then cargo test --workspace -- --test-threads=5; else echo "No Rust workspace yet; skipping Rust tests"; fi

typecheck.command: if [ -f Cargo.toml ] || [ -f rust-ag/Cargo.toml ]; then cargo check --workspace; else echo "No Rust workspace yet; skipping typecheck"; fi

lint.command: if [ -f Cargo.toml ] || [ -f rust-ag/Cargo.toml ]; then cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; else echo "No Rust workspace yet; skipping Rust lint"; fi

blockingIssues.description: Corpus manifest collection includes build-generated files under src/ (e.g., .dirstamp/config.h/stamp-h1), making manifest hashes non-reproducible from clean checkout.
scripts/parity/run_matrix.py tokenizes commands with str.split() after placeholder substitution, which breaks quoted arguments and paths/patterns containing spaces.
one-device traversal fixtures/scenarios were not implemented despite being in scope (metadata present but no fixture builder or scenario coverage).
Large-file edge-case reproducibility is unreliable on clean checkout due conditional fixture setup and integrity checks that do not require missing large fixture files.

appliedUpdates.description: Added parity command entries parity_baseline_smoke and parity_validate_latest so milestone verification steps are executable from shared commands.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add explicit reproducibility boundary: manifest-critical inputs must exclude build-generated/untracked files unless a normalization strategy is declared and validated from clean checkout; generated edge fixtures must be deterministically regenerated or required by integrity checks.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews for baseline-fixture-manifests-and-command-matrix and baseline-edge-case-fixtures found clean-checkout drift from generated/untracked inputs and conditional fixture setup.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Introduce a non-Rust tooling pathway and tighten procedure compliance checks so test-first requirements are evaluated against feature type (Rust code vs Python/tooling/manifests) and evidence in transcript skeleton.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Three reviews (baseline-fixture-manifests-and-command-matrix, baseline-parity-oracle-runner, rust-workspace-bootstrap-and-test-harness) reported mismatch between strict test-first wording and observed workflow while handoff marked followedProcedure=true.

rejectedObservations.observation: Duplicate test-first enforcement gap observations across multiple reviews.
Duplicate conventions observation about deterministic artifacts without explicit source-tracking/normalization guidance.
